name: Custom Heat Transfer Patches

metaDescription: B2B custom heat transfer patches with full-color, photo-quality reproduction for apparel, event merchandise and promotional products. Factory-direct production with artwork support.
heroSubtitle: Full-color heat-transfer patches with smooth, low-profile finish. Best for detailed artwork, gradients and photo-realistic designs applied directly to fabric with a heat press.
buyerSummary: Photo-quality heat-transfer patches for detailed, full-color artwork applied with a heat press — smooth finish, low profile and quick to produce.
overviewParagraphs: Custom heat transfer patches are printed full-color and applied to fabric using a heat press, producing a smooth, flexible, low-profile finish. They are ideal for designs that need gradients, photographic detail or fine full-color graphics that are difficult to reproduce with thread.

Compared with embroidered patches, heat transfer patches are thinner and lighter, making them a good fit for lightweight apparel, event merchandise and promotional products where a flat, print-quality finish is preferred.

faqs.question: What is the MOQ for heat transfer patches?
faqs.answer: MOQ: 200 pcs per design and construction for bulk production.

faqs.question: Can I request a pre-production sample?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production sample development is available for custom projects so you can verify color, finish and application before bulk production.

faqs.question: Can I submit an inquiry without final artwork?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can submit your project now and send artwork later, or provide a sketch or reference image for our team to review.

faqs.question: What design files can I send?
faqs.answer: PNG, JPG, PDF, AI or SVG files work well. Higher-resolution files with clear color references help us reproduce your design accurately.

faqs.question: Can you help choose the right patch construction?
faqs.answer: Yes. If you are unsure whether a heat transfer, embroidered or woven patch fits your design and application, our team can advise on the best option.

faqs.question: Can you provide test reports?
faqs.answer: Test reports and compliance documentation can be supported according to selected materials, product construction and destination-market requirements.

faqs.question: How are heat transfer patches packed and shipped?
faqs.answer: Individual or bulk packing is available, and shipment is arranged according to your confirmed order, destination and payment terms.
